mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the printer was worthwhile: the finished desk offered private receipts, deletion controls and a pencil alternative, making choice more than just a promise.

leastWorthwhile.text: My first attempt to fit the button was unproductive because the tablet needed preparation first.

surprise.text: The printer needed a separate controller assignment after being physically placed at the desk; fitting it did not automatically make it operational.

arbitrary.text: Combining the controller with the hooded tablet seemed sensible, but the resulting description did not clearly explain what the controller changed at that stage.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the tangible privacy choices and optional AI help made the repair more interesting than simply assembling a working device.
